title: Use ws_log for kerberos, roon_discovery, rpc
description:
Use the `ws_log` system instead of `fprintf()` for reporting messages
from the kerberos, roon_discovery, and rpc dissectors. If Wireshark
isn't compiled for a Debug target, the compiler will optimize away the
calls to log debug messages, and the rest will be presented in a
consistent way to the user.

Ping #19519
